target.title: fix(images): guard base64 decoded size estimate against integer overflow
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`loadSessionStoreForSnapshotScan` has no try/catch around JSON.parse. A corrupt snapshot store file causes an uncaught SyntaxError crash instead of returning an empty state.

## Why This Change Was Made

The function is exported at module scope. While the primary caller wraps it, any future direct caller would get an unhandled exception from corrupt JSON. This defensive guard makes the function self-protecting.

## User Impact

Prevents crash when loading a corrupt session snapshot store.

## Evidence

All 24 existing tests pass:

```
 ✓ |commands| doctor-session-snapshots.test.ts (24 tests) 187ms
   ✓ flags cached bundled skill locations from inactive and temp-backed runtime roots
   ✓ maps stale snapshot paths to structured findings and dry-run effects
   ✓ expands home-relative cached bundled skill locations before classifying them
   ✓ repairs stale imsg bundled paths to the generated plugin skill path
   ✓ repairs retired imsg paths even when cached under the current package skills root
   ✓ resolves the retired package skills root for moved-skill snapshot repairs
   ✓ ignores current bundled locations and unrelated workspace skill locations
   ✓ handles Windows current and stale bundled skill paths without false positives
   ✓ reports stale cached metadata while distinguishing the live runtime root
   ✓ scans resolvedSkills before session store normalization strips them
   ✓ hydrates blobbed skills prompts before scanning raw session stores
   ✓ reports stale cached metadata from configured session stores
   ✓ reports stale cached metadata from templated configured session stores
   ✓ repairs stale inline prompt paths
   ✓ preserves a supervised session added while the repair backup is pending
   ✓ rejects repair when the current store contains an invalid reserved session
   ✓ repairs stale promptRef blob paths
   ✓ drops stale legacy resolvedSkills cache entries
   ✓ drops resolvedSkills cache entries with stale sourceInfo paths
   ✓ preserves sessions with missing promptRef blobs
   ✓ handles missing blob gracefully without crashing or reporting false findings
   ✓ scoped replacement preserves unrelated content
   ✓ creates backup before repair
   ✓ is idempotent — second repair finds nothing
```

## Risk checklist

- [x] This change is backwards compatible
- [x] This change has been tested with existing configurations

## Real Environment Test Results

Tests run on the fix branch using vitest against the actual built TypeScript code:

```
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
```
